conversations.topic: Lenovo laptop and accessories bundle purchase

speakers.speaker: A
speakers.summary: Polite and professional throughout, explaining prices, accessories, and billing without irritation. Voice tone remains calm and steady.

speakers.speaker: B
speakers.summary: Matter-of-fact and cooperative, asking routine questions about the sealed unit, bag fit, and invoice discount before agreeing to billing. No frustrated wording or vocal tone; isolated acoustic spikes do not indicate agitation. Some salesperson wording appears mislabelled as B in segments 4 and 7.

customer_requested: The displayed Lenovo laptop model with sixteen GB RAM, with confirmation of the in-store price.
A sealed stock unit rather than the display unit.
To see the bag and confirm its padding and laptop fit.
To add the bag and mouse for ₹1,500.
Card payment and billing in Rahul Sharma's name, with the bundle discount shown on the invoice.

upsell_attempts.quote: Sir, iske saath laptop bag aur wireless mouse ka bundle le sakte ho. alak love to bag ek hazaar chaarso aur maus aapso ka hai laptop ke saath dono mila ke ek hazaar pandra padenge. total pachas hazaar chaarso nabbe ho jayega.
upsell_attempts.offered_item: Laptop bag and wireless mouse bundle

excluded_candidates: Ji, ye sola GB RAM aur panch so bara GB s s d wala hai. Final price artalis hazar nau so nabbe hai, g s t included. -> Answers the customer's question about the requested laptop and its price; no upgrade is suggested.

andar padded laptop compartment hai, is model ka sais aaram se fit ho jayega. Maus ke saath USB receiver bhi aata hai. -> Answers the customer's bag-fit and padding questions and describes an included receiver; not a separate upsell.
Bilkul, sir. Laptop, bag aur mouse mila ke pachas hazaar chaar sau nabbe. Bill kis naam se banaun? -> Confirms the already accepted purchase rather than making another offer.

accessories ka saath saur rupaye discount bill mein dikhega. pehle sealed box aur model check kar lije phir payment kar lenge. -> Answers the customer's invoice-discount question and explains the purchase checks; no new conditional discount or add-on is offered.
upsell.pushy_reason: The customer accepted the bag-and-mouse bundle after checking the bag's suitability. There was no rejected upsell, repeated pressure, or customer frustration.
upsell.summary: One proactive bag-and-wireless-mouse bundle upsell was made and accepted. The introduction beginning “Sir, iske saath” appears mislabeled as B; its wording and A's immediately following pricing explanation indicate that it is salesperson speech.
upsell.greeting_quote: Hello, sir; bataiye kya dekhna tha.
upsell.coaching_feedback: You offered a relevant bag-and-mouse bundle after the customer chose the laptop, then answered the padding, fit, and invoice-discount questions before billing. Next time, state the bundle price and savings clearly and consistently: the wording “ek hazaar pandra” differs from the customer's “pandra sau,” so explicitly confirming ₹1,500 would remove ambiguity.

speakers.speaker: A
speakers.summary: Remains calm and polite while promoting the wireless option, then apologizes and fulfills the customer's original request. No clear frustration.

speakers.speaker: B
speakers.summary: Briefly becomes impatient when the salesperson continues upselling after a clear budget limit and refusal. Returns to a steady, practical tone after the apology and completes the purchase.

frustration_moments.speaker: B
frustration_moments.quote: arey nahi, bola na, roz istimaal bhi nahi karna hai saadhe chaar sau wala nikalo bas.
frustration_moments.evidence: “bola na” and “nikalo bas” express impatience at having to repeat the choice after another upsell. The voice is also labeled frustrated and insistent, with slight impatience; modestly elevated loudness provides supporting evidence.

customer_requested: A wired mouse for a laptop costing no more than ₹500.
The ₹450 wired mouse, with both buttons and the middle wheel demonstrated before packing.
The bill placed inside the box.

upsell_attempts.quote: waise aap somi ye bina taar wala bhi hai, teen sau pachas aur lagenge, mez par taar ka jhanjhat nahi rahega, wo kar doon?
upsell_attempts.offered_item: Wireless mouse costing ₹350 more than the selected wired mouse.

upsell_attempts.quote: samajh gaya, par ek baar haath mein pakad kar dekh lijiye, pakad bhi achhi hai, laptop ke saath le jana aasaan rahega.
upsell_attempts.offered_item: The same wireless mouse, re-offered through a hands-on trial and grip and portability benefits.

excluded_candidates: ye wala saadhe chaar sau ka hai, saadharan u s bee wala hai, lagate hi chal jayega. -> Provides the wired mouse the customer requested, within the stated budget.
dedh meter hai, dibbe par bhi likha hai, ye dekhiye. -> Directly answers the customer's question about cord length.

bilkul, ye dekhiye, dono button chal rahe hain aur panna upar neeche bhi ho raha hai Bil samt sahi char sau hi hai. -> Demonstrates the requested mouse functions and discusses billing; no additional purchase is suggested.
upsell.pushy_reason: After the customer explicitly said “paanch so se upar nahi jana. taar wala hi chahiye,” A continued promoting the wireless mouse's grip and portability. This prompted the impatient response “arey nahi, bola na” before A apologized and stopped.
upsell.summary: A made two upgrade attempts from the selected ₹450 wired mouse to a wireless mouse costing ₹350 more. The second attempt followed a clear refusal and budget limit, causing impatience; A then apologized and proceeded with the original choice.
upsell.customer_feedback: The customer reiterated that they would not go above ₹500, would not use the mouse daily, and wanted only the ₹450 wired option.

unanswered_questions.speaker: B
unanswered_questions.question: Theek hai, ye paise lo, bil dibbe mein rakh dena.
unanswered_questions.note: The transcript ends without an acknowledgment or confirmation that the bill was placed inside the box; fulfillment is not shown.

upsell.coaching_feedback: You answered the cord-length question directly and demonstrated both buttons and scrolling as requested; apologizing with “maaf kijiye” also helped restore a practical tone. Once the customer said “paanch so se upar nahi jana,” accept that limit and complete the wired-mouse purchase rather than repeating the wireless pitch.

speakers.speaker: A
speakers.summary: Straightforward and accommodating, with no frustrated wording or tone. Segment 35 appears to be a customer request despite the salesperson label.

speakers.speaker: B
speakers.summary: Offers a polite, steady greeting; the brief turn contains no evidence of frustration.

speakers.speaker: C
speakers.summary: Polite and relaxed throughout, becoming pleased with the working mouse and successful purchase. This label includes both customer and salesperson turns, suggesting diarization errors; neither role shows frustration.

customer_requested: A basic wired mouse for a laptop, under five hundred rupees.
To see the mouse and test its clicks.
To purchase one mouse, pay by UPI, and receive a bill.
excluded_candidates: Yes, this one is three hundred ninety nine rupees. It has a regular u_s_b_ connection. -> Recommendation of the requested basic wired mouse within the customer's budget, not an upgrade.
Sure, here is the display piece. You can check the size and grip. -> Fulfills the customer's request to see the mouse.
Certainly; I've connected it to this laptop. Please try both buttons and the scroll wheel. -> Fulfills the customer's request to test the mouse, rather than suggesting an additional purchase.
Okay, I'll get a sealed box of the same model. -> Supplies the model the customer already agreed to buy; no additional item or upgrade.
upsell.pushy_reason: The salesperson supplied the requested mouse without suggesting extras or pushing a higher-priced option.
upsell.summary: No upsell was attempted. The salesperson demonstrated a 399-rupee wired mouse within the customer's 500-rupee budget and completed the purchase. Speaker labels are inconsistent, so roles were inferred from the requests and responses.
upsell.coaching_feedback: You matched the under-five-hundred-rupee request with a 399-rupee mouse and let the customer test the buttons and scroll wheel, helping them confidently say, “I'll take one.” Add a brief greeting in response to “Hello sir” before moving into the product recommendation.
